Instructions to disable battery optimization so Eltharion keeps running in the background
Disable battery optimization so Eltharion never stops monitoring WiFi.

Android battery saver can pause background RSSI monitoring when your screen is locked.

1. Tap Open Battery Settings below.
2. Find Eltharion (or tap App Battery Usage).
3. Choose Unrestricted / Don't optimize so Auto-Pause stays active consistently.
Keep Eltharion\'s RSSI Guard persistent when the screen locks or switches apps.
1. Tap Open Battery Optimization (or Eltharion App Battery Info for OEM devices).
2. Find Eltharion (switch filter to All apps if hidden).
3. Select Unrestricted or Don\'t optimize to prevent background pauses.
Add Eltharion next to Internet & Bluetooth in your phone\'s top swipe-down panel so you can turn protection on or off without opening the app.
